| King on day $n$ \ King on day $n+1$ | Adam | Bill | Chris |
|---|---|---|---|
| Adam | $\frac13$ | $\frac13$ | $\frac13$ |
| Bill | $\frac12$ | $\frac14$ | $\frac14$ |
| Chris | $0$ | $0$ | $1$ |
